notes: French internal flows: real MOBPRO commune-to-commune O-D table. Swiss internal flows: no fine O-D matrix, gravity model hard-constrained to real STATENT employment totals per canton minus real cross-border commuter counts. German internal flows: same gravity approach, constrained to a mix of real (Weil am Rhein, Lörrach) and estimated (other communes, via a jobs/population ratio derived from the two known communes) employment totals — this is the one genuinely estimated component of the pipeline, flagged explicitly rather than presented as sourced. Cross-border flows: real OFS quarterly cross-border commuter statistics, separately for French residents (by department) and German residents (by Landkreis), by canton of work.
